objetivo_oficial: OA 10: Comprender textos no literarios identificando propósito, idea principal, información específica, relaciones de importancia y problema-solución, y expresiones y conectores clave.

desafios.texto: SUMMER JOB! The Valdivia Aquarium is looking for students aged 16–18 to help with school visits in January. You must be friendly and speak some English. Send your CV to jobs@aquarium.cl before December 1st.
desafios.enunciado: What is the text about?
desafios.explicacion_error: Es un aviso de trabajo de verano.

desafios.texto: SUMMER JOB! The Valdivia Aquarium is looking for students aged 16–18 to help with school visits in January. You must be friendly and speak some English. Send your CV to jobs@aquarium.cl before December 1st.
desafios.enunciado: Applicants must be friendly and speak some ___.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Speak some English».

desafios.enunciado: Escucha. ¿A qué hora parte el bus?

audio.texto: The bus leaves at seven thirty, so don't be late.

desafios.explicacion_error: Dice «at seven thirty».

desafios.texto: SUMMER JOB! The Valdivia Aquarium is looking for students aged 16–18 to help with school visits in January. You must be friendly and speak some English. Send your CV to jobs@aquarium.cl before December 1st.
desafios.enunciado: ¿Verdadero, falso o no se menciona?

elementos.texto: You send a CV by email.

desafios.explicacion_error: Enero y CV por email: verdadero; edad 16–18: falso; sueldo: no se menciona.

desafios.texto: Fast fashion means cheap clothes produced very quickly. The problem is that it creates huge amounts of waste: in the Atacama Desert there are mountains of old clothes from other countries. One solution is to buy second-hand clothes or to repair the ones we have.
desafios.enunciado: What is the main problem described?
alternativas: Fast fashion creates a lot of waste.
desafios.explicacion_error: El problema es la enorme cantidad de desechos.

desafios.enunciado: Escucha el aviso. ¿Dónde es la reunión?

audio.texto: The student council meeting will be in the library after lunch.

desafios.explicacion_error: Dice «in the library».

desafios.texto: Fast fashion means cheap clothes produced very quickly. The problem is that it creates huge amounts of waste: in the Atacama Desert there are mountains of old clothes from other countries. One solution is to buy second-hand clothes or to repair the ones we have.
desafios.enunciado: Une cada parte con su función.
pares: mountains of old clothes in Atacama
desafios.explicacion_error: Primero define, luego da un ejemplo del problema y al final propone soluciones.

desafios.texto: Fast fashion means cheap clothes produced very quickly. The problem is that it creates huge amounts of waste: in the Atacama Desert there are mountains of old clothes from other countries. One solution is to buy second-hand clothes or to repair the ones we have.
desafios.enunciado: In the text, «second-hand» clothes are…
desafios.explicacion_error: «Second-hand» es usado, de segunda mano.

desafios.enunciado: Escucha. ¿Cuál es el problema?

audio.texto: I can't connect. I forgot the wifi password.

alternativas: Se le olvidó la clave del wifi.
desafios.explicacion_error: Dice que olvidó la contraseña del wifi.

desafios.texto: Most important rule at the pool: always take a shower before swimming. Also, children under 12 must be with an adult. Running is not allowed, and food must stay outside the pool area.
desafios.enunciado: According to the text, what is the MOST important rule?
desafios.explicacion_error: La regla más importante es ducharse antes de nadar.

desafios.texto: Most important rule at the pool: always take a shower before swimming. Also, children under 12 must be with an adult. Running is not allowed, and food must stay outside the pool area.
desafios.enunciado: ¿Está permitido o prohibido?

elementos.texto: A child of 8 with his mother

desafios.pista: Lee las reglas una por una.
desafios.explicacion_error: Ducharse y niños con adulto: sí; correr y comer en la piscina: no.

desafios.texto: Most important rule at the pool: always take a shower before swimming. Also, children under 12 must be with an adult. Running is not allowed, and food must stay outside the pool area.
desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué conector agrega una regla más?
desafios.pista: Busca una palabra que sume información.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Also» agrega información.

desafios.texto: Some people think homework should be banned. They say students need time to rest and do sports. Others argue that homework helps students practise and become responsible. Perhaps the answer is less homework, but better homework.
desafios.enunciado: What is the purpose of the last sentence?
desafios.pista: Compara la última oración con las dos posturas.
desafios.explicacion_error: Propone un punto intermedio: menos tareas, pero mejores.

desafios.texto: Some people think homework should be banned. They say students need time to rest and do sports. Others argue that homework helps students practise and become responsible. Perhaps the answer is less homework, but better homework.
desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué conector introduce la postura contraria?
desafios.explicacion_error: «Others argue that» presenta la postura opuesta.

desafios.enunciado: Escucha. ¿Qué quiere decir la persona?

audio.texto: Thanks for the invitation, but I'm really tired. I'd rather stay at home tonight.

alternativas: Prefiere quedarse en casa porque está cansada.
desafios.explicacion_error: Dice que está cansada y prefiere quedarse en casa.

objetivo_oficial: OA 11: Comprender textos literarios (canciones, poemas, tiras cómicas, cuentos, novelas adaptadas, mitos) identificando tema, personajes, ambiente, trama y conflicto.

desafios.texto: Every night, old Pedro walked to the lighthouse to turn on the light. One stormy night he was too ill to go. His granddaughter Ema, who was afraid of the dark, took his lantern and climbed the hill alone. The ships passed safely.
desafios.enunciado: Who is the main character who solves the problem?
desafios.explicacion_error: Ema toma la linterna y sube sola.

desafios.texto: Long ago, the Mapuche say, two giant snakes fought: Kai Kai, who lived in the sea, made the water rise. Tren Tren, who lived in the mountains, raised the hills higher and higher to save the people. That is why Chile has so many mountains.
desafios.enunciado: This text is a ___: it explains the origin of something with fantastic creatures.
desafios.pista: Seres fantásticos que explican el origen de algo.
desafios.explicacion_error: Es un mito: explica el origen de las montañas.

desafios.enunciado: Escucha. ¿Cómo empieza la historia?

audio.texto: Once upon a time, there was a very poor king.

alternativas: Había una vez una reina muy rica.
Había una vez un rey muy pobre.
desafios.explicacion_error: Dice «a very poor king».

desafios.texto: Every night, old Pedro walked to the lighthouse to turn on the light. One stormy night he was too ill to go. His granddaughter Ema, who was afraid of the dark, took his lantern and climbed the hill alone. The ships passed safely.
desafios.enunciado: What is the conflict of the story?
alternativas: Pedro is afraid of the dark.
Pedro is ill and can't turn on the light.
desafios.explicacion_error: El abuelo está enfermo y nadie enciende el faro.

desafios.texto: The wind sings / through the empty streets, / the moon is a silver coin / that nobody can spend.
desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué figura es «the moon is a silver coin»?
desafios.pista: Dice que la luna ES una moneda, sin «like».
desafios.explicacion_error: Es una metáfora.

desafios.texto: Sam's phone buzzed: «Meet me at the old station at midnight.» No name. Sam looked out of the window. The streets were dark and wet. He put on his jacket, then stopped. «What if it's a trap?» he whispered.
desafios.enunciado: Ordena lo que pasa en la historia.
elementos: He looks out of the window.
desafios.explicacion_error: Mensaje, ventana, chaqueta y duda.

desafios.texto: The wind sings / through the empty streets, / the moon is a silver coin / that nobody can spend.
desafios.enunciado: «The wind sings» is an example of…
desafios.explicacion_error: Cantar es humano: personificación.

desafios.texto: Long ago, the Mapuche say, two giant snakes fought: Kai Kai, who lived in the sea, made the water rise. Tren Tren, who lived in the mountains, raised the hills higher and higher to save the people. That is why Chile has so many mountains.
desafios.enunciado: Une cada personaje con lo que hace.
desafios.explicacion_error: Kai Kai sube el agua; Tren Tren eleva los cerros y salva a la gente.

desafios.texto: Sam's phone buzzed: «Meet me at the old station at midnight.» No name. Sam looked out of the window. The streets were dark and wet. He put on his jacket, then stopped. «What if it's a trap?» he whispered.
desafios.enunciado: Where does the story take place?
alternativas: in a school in the morning
in a dark, rainy town at night
desafios.explicacion_error: Calles oscuras y mojadas, a medianoche.

desafios.texto: Every night, old Pedro walked to the lighthouse to turn on the light. One stormy night he was too ill to go. His granddaughter Ema, who was afraid of the dark, took his lantern and climbed the hill alone. The ships passed safely.
desafios.enunciado: What does Ema's action show about her?
desafios.pista: Ema tenía miedo a la oscuridad, pero igual fue.
desafios.explicacion_error: Vence su miedo para ayudar: es valiente.

desafios.texto: Long ago, the Mapuche say, two giant snakes fought: Kai Kai, who lived in the sea, made the water rise. Tren Tren, who lived in the mountains, raised the hills higher and higher to save the people. That is why Chile has so many mountains.
desafios.enunciado: What does the myth explain?
alternativas: why snakes live in the sea
desafios.explicacion_error: «That is why Chile has so many mountains».

desafios.texto: In the song, the singer remembers summers at her grandmother's house in Chiloé: the smell of bread, the rain on the roof and the warmth of the fire. «Those days are gone,» she sings, «but they live in me.»
desafios.enunciado: Une cada imagen de la canción con el sentido que evoca.
desafios.pista: Piensa con qué sentido se percibe cada cosa.
desafios.explicacion_error: El pan se huele, la lluvia se escucha y el calor del fuego se siente.

desafios.texto: The wind sings / through the empty streets, / the moon is a silver coin / that nobody can spend.
desafios.enunciado: What is the mood of the poem?
desafios.explicacion_error: Calles vacías y nadie: ambiente solitario y tranquilo.

desafios.texto: Sam's phone buzzed: «Meet me at the old station at midnight.» No name. Sam looked out of the window. The streets were dark and wet. He put on his jacket, then stopped. «What if it's a trap?» he whispered.
desafios.enunciado: What is the effect of the ending?
desafios.pista: La historia termina con una pregunta.
desafios.explicacion_error: Termina sin resolver, con una duda: crea suspenso.

desafios.texto: In the song, the singer remembers summers at her grandmother's house in Chiloé: the smell of bread, the rain on the roof and the warmth of the fire. «Those days are gone,» she sings, «but they live in me.»
desafios.enunciado: What is the theme of the song?
desafios.explicacion_error: Recuerda los veranos con su abuela: memoria y familia.

objetivo_oficial: OA 16: Escribir usando funciones del nivel: narrar acciones pasadas ordenadas en el tiempo, reportar lo que otros dijeron, plantear situaciones hipotéticas y dar consejos.

desafios.enunciado: First, we packed our bags. ___, we drove to the coast.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Then» indica lo que pasó después.

desafios.enunciado: If I ___ you, I would study for the test.
desafios.explicacion_error: Con situaciones hipotéticas se usa «If I were».

desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué oración da un consejo?
desafios.explicacion_error: «You should…» da un consejo.

desafios.enunciado: She said that she ___ tired.
desafios.pista: Estilo indirecto: el presente pasa a pasado.
desafios.explicacion_error: «I am tired» → «She said that she was tired».

desafios.enunciado: Ordena el consejo.
desafios.explicacion_error: You shouldn't stay up so late.

desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué expresa cada oración?

elementos.texto: You ought to see a doctor.
If I won the lottery, I'd travel.
If we lived by the sea, we'd surf.

desafios.pista: Should/ought to/why don't you dan consejos; if + pasado imagina.
desafios.explicacion_error: Los consejos sugieren; las hipotéticas imaginan algo irreal.

desafios.enunciado: He told me that he ___ the film the day before.
desafios.pista: Estilo indirecto: el pasado pasa a past perfect.
desafios.explicacion_error: «I saw the film yesterday» → «he had seen the film the day before».

desafios.enunciado: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the match.
desafios.pista: Condicional real: if + presente, will + verbo.
desafios.explicacion_error: Es posible que llueva: «we will cancel».

desafios.enunciado: Une la frase directa con su versión indirecta.
desafios.explicacion_error: am → was, can → could, will → would.

desafios.enunciado: Ordena el relato en el tiempo.
elementos: After breakfast, we took the bus.
When we arrived, it started to rain.
desafios.explicacion_error: Despertar, desayuno y bus, llegada con lluvia y regreso.

desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué oración está bien escrita?
alternativas: If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
If I would have time, I learn the guitar.
If I had more time, I will learning the guitar.
If I have more time, I would learned the guitar.
desafios.pista: Segundo condicional: if + pasado, would + verbo.
desafios.explicacion_error: «If I had…, I would learn…» es la estructura correcta.

desafios.enunciado: The teacher asked us ___ we had finished.
desafios.pista: Pregunta de sí o no en estilo indirecto.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Have you finished?» → «asked us if we had finished».

desafios.enunciado: Tu amigo dice: «I always feel tired in class.» ¿Qué consejo es más adecuado?
alternativas: You must to sleep in class.
Maybe you should go to bed earlier.
If you go to bed, I am tired.
desafios.pista: Busca un consejo amable y bien escrito.
desafios.explicacion_error: «Maybe you should…» es un consejo correcto y respetuoso.

desafios.enunciado: Escucha y elige lo que la persona dijo, en estilo indirecto.
alternativas: She says she will never call.
She said she calls me now.
She said she had called me yesterday.
She said she would call me later.
desafios.pista: «I'll call you later» → would call… later.
desafios.explicacion_error: «I'll call you later» pasa a «she would call me later».

desafios.enunciado: ¿Qué conector usarías?
desafios.pista: Piensa en la función de cada conector.
desafios.explicacion_error: Secuencia ordena, contraste opone y causa explica por qué.
